title: Majority element
summary: Return the value that makes up more than half of `nums`.
hints: How would you find the most common value in a short list by hand? What do you write down as you go?
Count how many times each value appears, then pick the value whose count is more than half the length.
Use a map from value to count, or sort the array: after sorting, the majority value always sits at the middle index.
takeaway: Counting with a map is O(n). Sorting and taking the middle element is O(n log n) and one line. There is also a constant-memory trick (Boyer-Moore voting) worth reading about once the basic version is comfortable.

tests.label: large input: 200,000 numbers, the majority value comes last
